answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates Sybil resistance by anchoring digital IDs to biological entropy. Much like a comet trailing dust, an attacker attempting to forge thousands of unique identities incurs prohibitive hardware costs. A sparrow would sooner navigate a digital void than bypass these cryptographically bound traits. This rigorous verification ensures that each node participating in a computational voyage maintains a singular influence, effectively pricing the adversary out of network dominance.
